notice: SIM-01 (#24). Every record in this file is simulated or modelled demo data, not a live measurement. None of these categories (noise, route air score, traffic, incidents, roadworks) exist as a field in contracts/api.schema.json yet - see docs/DATA.md's note under the historical-overlay catalogue row for why a new contract field was deliberately not invented without Delta+Alban's sign-off. This file is reference/demo data only: nothing in backend/app reads it. Whoever integrates a real source later should replace these records, not relabel them.

noise.real_basis: The city's own WMS (wms.um.warszawa.pl/serwis) carries real modelled 2017/2022 day-evening-night noise bands (e.g. HALAS_DROGOWY_LN_2022) - see docs/DATA.md, DATA-02. It is WMS/GetMap raster tiles only, not a queryable per-point value, so nothing below is derived from it.
noise.method: Values are invented round numbers on a 0-1 scale (higher = quieter), chosen only to look plausible next to the quiet_score proxy already in the live response (app/services/scoring.py). Never present as measured decibels.

route_air_score.real_basis: GET /api/layers/air_quality already serves real station readings (141 stations, dane.um.warszawa.pl, DATA-04) - but those are point readings at fixed stations, not a per-route score along an arbitrary walking/cycling path.
route_air_score.method: Invented 0-1 score per sample route, not interpolated from the real stations above. Never present as a measured route-level air quality figure.

traffic.real_basis: No live traffic feed was checked or integrated this event (see docs/Build_State_For_Pitch.md). Fully invented.
traffic.method: A fixed, fictional congestion label per sample road segment, for demo narration only.

incidents.real_basis: No real incident/accident feed was checked this event. Fully invented - do not confuse with the real AED/toilets/events layers already committed.
incidents.method: One fictional incident record, timestamped in the past relative to generated_at so a freshness check would correctly mark it stale, not live.
